videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team gamble on restoring a Vanden Plas saloon from the 1970s and a child's tricycle from the 1960s. Plus, catch up on the restoration of a rare Sunbeam Lotus.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: Derek encourages the team to buy a Francis Barnett Plover at auction. Plus, the wheels come off the restoration of an MG Metro.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: Derek thinks a 29,000-mile Ford Capri should be kept original. Plus, a Hercules women's racing bike from the '50s.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: Derek picks out a solid-looking 1969 MGB for the team to look out for at auction. After winning it is sent to a father-and-son team to restore.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: Dave alerts the team to a 1979 Lotus Esprit S3. The car is a thoroughbred classic that desperately needs a proper restoration, but it's also an expensive purchase that risks not paying off.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The Restoring Classics team pays tribute to mid-80s Midlands by breathing new life into what was once the fastest production MG ever made: the Montego Turbo.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: A sun-bleached red Vauxhall Astra GTE gives the team a headache. They also buy a classic French moped and catch up on the restoration of a barn find Mini Cooper S.

videos.description: The team break with tradition and actually follow Dave Mathewson's advice on what to restore.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team restore a 1988 Golf GTI Convertible - an iconic hot hatch - along with a wooden launch boat and catch-up on a Mk1 Austin Mini.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: A super-rare Renault Clio Williams 2 in F1 blue with contrasting gold alloys has turned Dave Mathewson an interesting shade of green.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team snap up a slightly saggy Seventies Saab 96, but despite a stunning restoration, could it result in a record financial loss when it goes to auction?

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team purchase a 1950's Austin Westminster rally car in the hope that seasoned competitor Dave Mathewson can win a race.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: A super rare Reliant Scimitar GTC undergoes an expert recommission, leaving no bolt unturned. And a Honda CBR superbike from the 80s is in need of repair.

videos.description: The team are on the hunt to restore one of the greatest names in motoring history - the Bugatti. But with a strict budget they settle for a replica.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Derek heads to Northumberland to collect a rare 1975 NSU RO 80, Jack draws the short straw again with a Mini Mayfair stuck in a barn, and an Aston Martin DBS husk is auctioned.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: On the way to pick up two lovely '70s Lotus sports cars, Derek takes to the skies for his first ever helicopter flight in a 1967 Bell 47 chopper.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Dave's drawn to a Fiat Uno 45 in hearing aid beige, a well-known manufacturer's colour, with 36,000 miles on the clock.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Paul hits the road to collect an old navy ambulance that served its time as a holiday camper.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Dave travels to Bedale to extract a barn find - a 1984 Manta GTE which hasn't seen the light of day in thirty years.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: There's Hollywood glamour in the air as Derek heads out to pick up a Rolls Royce that once belonged to Fred Astaire.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Austin Healeys are classic British vehicles that are difficult to tame. Paul and Charlie have the rare chance to pick up a trio of these iconic cars in varying conditions.
